extracted.intended_audience: Prospective applicants to the University of Iowa Summer Writers' Workshops (graduate-level writers and other adult applicants); also high-school students interested in the Iowa Young Writers' Studio.
extracted.subtask_description: Information and requirements for applying to the University of Iowa Summer Writers' Workshops — three-week, graduate-level in-person fiction and poetry workshops taught for credit. Includes admission basis, session format, dates, and program-level eligibility notes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Admission: manuscript review
rubrics_metrics.description: Admission is based on manuscript review and is open to all applicants, whether currently enrolled in a degree program or not.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications for summer 2026 will open January 12th and close March 2nd.

rubrics_metrics.name: Course level and credit
rubrics_metrics.description: The Workshop will offer graduate-level courses for credit. Earned credits will be recorded on an official transcript.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Classes are taught by Writers' Workshop permanent and visiting faculty and follow the graduate workshop format.

rubrics_metrics.name: Session format and duration
rubrics_metrics.description: Three-week graduate workshops held in person (e.g., '3-week graduate fiction workshop, in person').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specific sessions and faculty are scheduled (multiple May–June and July sessions listed for fiction and poetry).

rubrics_metrics.name: Program instruction: faculty
rubrics_metrics.description: Classes are taught by Writers' Workshop permanent and visiting faculty.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Instruction follows the graduate workshop format (implying workshop-style critique and seminar structure).

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility: separate program for high-school students
rubrics_metrics.description: The Iowa Young Writers' Studio offers summer classes dedicated to high school students.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Summer Workshops (graduate-level) are open to all adult applicants; the Young Writers' Studio is a distinct program for high-school students.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application logistics: mailing list and notifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Prospective applicants can join the Summer Program mailing list to receive updates and application information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subscription requires confirming via an email confirmation link ('Yes, subscribe me to this list' in the confirmation email).
